title: groups.json
description: Your groups: boxes on the page, each with a name and a colour, holding the plugins you put in it, in your order.

id.x-plain: can only have small letters, numbers and dashes
id.description: Never changes, so a group can be renamed.

note.description: A line of your own under the name.

colour.x-plain: should be a colour's name in small letters, like lilac

plugins.description: The plugins in it, by folder name, in your order.
